instruction: Pick up the cup and bowl from the counter, place them in the dishwasher, and close the dishwasher door.

stage_definitions.counts_as_complete: at least one of the two dishes rests on the dishwasher rack and the gripper is no longer touching it.
stage_definitions.does_not_count: no dish is on the rack yet (dishes still on the counter, held, or on the open door).

stage_definitions.counts_as_complete: both dishes rest on the dishwasher rack and the gripper is not touching either of them.
stage_definitions.does_not_count: only one dish is on the rack, or the gripper is still holding / touching the second dish.

stage_definitions.counts_as_complete: both dishes are on the rack and the dishwasher door is fully closed.
stage_definitions.does_not_count: the door is open or only partly closed, or a dish is not on the rack.
